clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the apple orchard, within the following year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees and distant from June, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June keeping to her bed for weeks that winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir with her anxiety easing and functioning rising by September 1953. The shifts pile up across 18 months as the family settled into the new place and Walter's relationship with his brother ended.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan: Walter drinking heavily most nights by June, Walter and Glen blaming each other over the loan, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Carl's asthma easing once spring came, you beginning to wet the bed in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found and told to stop working at the bakery in May, and Walter stopping drinking by October and taking work pruning trees. The orchard sold at auction in October 1968 and the family moved to Ridgeport; Glen began at the cannery in February 1969. The shifts span from the crop failure through the following spring as the family faced the loss of the orchard and Walter's functioning rose.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975: Glen out of work most of that year and sitting in the truck for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, you stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, you keeping to your room and distant from your mother, Walter drinking again after six years off it by December, and you eating again and making the track team by June 1976. Glen started driving a delivery truck for the feed store in March 1976. The shifts cluster around the job loss and Glen's fall in functioning, with your own and your family's trouble rising and settling as Glen found work again.
